title: Healthleap Raises $38M After Scaling AI Tool to 50 Hospitals
summary:
Sequoia, First Round, and Hummingbird led the latest financing for a venture specializing in early disease detection. The startup, Healthleap, secured $38M in total funding, comprising a $30M Series A and an $8M seed round, to expand its AI screening software that identifies patients at risk of undiagnosed illnesses. The company's footprint has grown from 3 hospitals to more than 50 in the past 12 months.

Clinical implementations have yielded 39% more appropriate diagnoses at Cedars-Sinai using existing staff and an average reduction of 1.6 days in hospital stays per at-risk patient at Penn. Healthleap is currently hiring for all roles to support its commercial expansion into the healthcare market.

Announcing $38M Seed & Series A from Sequoia, First Round, and Hummingbird.

Healthleap's mission is to improve the health outcomes of as many people as possible. 

Results so far: 
• faster healing resulting in 1.6 shorter hospital stays per patient flagged as at risk by HealthLeap (Penn)
• 39% more appropriate diagnoses, same staff (Cedars-Sinai) 
• 3 → 50+ hospitals in the past year 

We're hiring across all roles.
